subject: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 24, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)

Aisha,

We’re packaging the marketplace security bundle for AWS/GCP review + customer questionnaires.

Could you please redline:
1) “Marketplace Security Overview” wording (claims/precision)
2) Evidence references (what we can/should point to vs gated)

Timing: hoping to lock copy today (Fri) so we can merge docs PR early next week.

Key places where we expect sensitivity:
- SOC 2 / ISO wording
- Data retention + “no training” language
- Encryption / KMS phrasing
- Audit logs: what’s available to Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private

Attachments:
- Redwood_Marketplace_Security_Packet_Index_v1.0.docx
- Marketplace_Security_Overview_v0.9.pdf
- DataFlow_Marketplace_Subscription_to_Provisioning_v3.png
- Evidence_Link_Map_v0.4.xlsx

Thanks,
Alex

—
Alex Martinez
DevEx Lead, Redwood Inference


From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 24, 2026 at 11:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)

Thanks — reviewed. High-level: structure is good, but we need to tighten a few claims.

Redlines / required changes (please implement before publish/submission):

SOC 2 / ISO
- Replace “SOC 2 certified” → “SOC 2 Type II report available upon request under NDA.”
- If we mention ISO at all, we must say “ISO-aligned controls” unless/until we are explicitly certified and can share cert scope.
- Add a single sentence that scope is the Redwood Inference platform + operations; not customer applications.

Data handling
- “We do not store prompts” is too absolute. Replace with “By default, we retain API request/response payloads for X days for abuse prevention and debugging; customers can configure retention (including reduced retention) depending on deployment mode.” Align exactly with the data retention page.
- “We do not train on customer data” needs to be “We do not use customer prompts/outputs to train our models by default.” (Avoid “never”/absolute language.)

Encryption
- “Encrypted at rest” is OK but please specify: encryption at rest for production systems and backups; keys managed via cloud KMS (Hosted) and via customer-managed keys for Private where applicable.
- Avoid listing specific cipher suites. “TLS in transit” is sufficient unless a reviewer explicitly asks.

Audit logs
- Don’t imply Hosted customers get the same audit log export as Private. Suggest a table by deployment mode:
  - Hosted: console + API key events, org/admin events; export via API (where available)
  - Dedicated: same as Hosted + dedicated environment configuration changes
  - Private: full audit log export and SIEM integration patterns (customer environment)

Regulated claims
- Remove the line “supports HIPAA workloads” (even if true in practice, this triggers additional review). Safer: “supports deployment in regulated environments; contact us for compliance requirements.”

Shared responsibility
- Add a “Shared responsibility (summary)” section that explicitly calls out:
  - Redwood: platform security, runtime, infra controls for Hosted/Dedicated; patching, monitoring, incident response
  - Customer: application-layer access control, prompt content, end-user authentication, data classification

Olga: can you confirm which evidence links are safe to reference publicly vs “available upon request”?

Aisha

—
Dr. Aisha Rahman
Security Executive Sponsor, Redwood Inference


From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 24, 2026 at 12:26 PM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)

Confirming evidence link guidance.

OK to reference publicly (docs site / marketplace attachments):
- High-level security overview (no control-by-control assertions)
- Data retention defaults + configurable controls (no customer names)
- Audit logging overview (event categories, not screenshots with internal IDs)
- Shared responsibility summary

Must be “available upon request under NDA” / gated (not marketplace public listing):
- SOC 2 Type II report PDF
- Pen test report(s)
- Detailed vulnerability management and incident postmortems
- Vendor/subprocessor list with specific hosting vendors (we can provide a separate “Subprocessor List” page later; for now keep generic: “major cloud providers”)

Suggested wording for evidence line:
- “SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence available upon request under NDA.”

Also, please remove “meets ISO 27001” anywhere it appears. We can say “ISO 27001-aligned controls” only.

Olga

—
Olga Petrov
GRC Lead, Redwood Inference


From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 24, 2026 at 1:08 PM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)

Got it. For the docs PR (PR-3422) I’ll update the public pages to:
- Remove/replace absolute claims (per Aisha)
- Add a short “Evidence available on request” section with NDA note

Question: do we want to publish retention defaults numerically (e.g., “30 days”) on the public page, or keep it as “X days” and link to the internal retention page?

The marketplace reviewers tend to want a number, but we don’t want drift if defaults change.

Elliot

—
Elliot Price
Docs Lead, Redwood Inference


From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 24, 2026 at 2:02 PM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)

Recommend we publish the numeric defaults (what they are today) AND include a “may change” disclaimer + “see console settings” language.

Proposed phrasing:
- “Default retention is 30 days for Hosted logs and request metadata; customers can configure retention settings depending on deployment mode.”

This matches what prospects ask in security reviews and avoids the “X days” ambiguity.

Naomi

—
Naomi Feldman
Security/Compliance Product Owner, Redwood Inference


From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 24, 2026 at 3:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)

One more technical nit:

In the overview PDF, it says “customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) available for all deployments.” That’s not true for Hosted today.

Please update to:
- Hosted/Dedicated: keys managed in cloud KMS by Redwood (with strict access controls)
- Private: customer-managed key options available (cloud KMS / HSM integrations depending on environment)

Also “SIEM integration” should be framed as:
- Hosted/Dedicated: export via API / configured sinks (where available)
- Private: customer can forward audit logs within their environment

Marcus

—
Marcus Lin
Security Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference


From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Jan 25, 2026 at 10:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace security packet — wording + evidence references review (redlines needed by EOD Fri)

Approving to proceed once the following are incorporated (all must be in the final marketplace packet and public docs):

1) SOC 2 language fixed (no “certified”; NDA gating)
2) No HIPAA claims; no “meets ISO 27001” (only “ISO-aligned controls”)
3) Retention wording aligned to the retention page; no absolutes (“do not store prompts”)
4) KMS/customer-managed key claims corrected per Marcus
5) Add shared responsibility summary section

Once updated, please send me the final PDF (or doc link) you intend to attach for AWS/GCP submission so I can do a quick final pass.

Aisha

—
Dr. Aisha Rahman
Security Executive Sponsor, Redwood Inference
